name: code-field
title: Code field
description: A one-time code, one slot per character, at Field's sizes: each slot is the field well and a filled one holds a keycap that springs in as it is typed; a paste or the phone's autofill (autocomplete one-time-code) sets them in one ripple. Groups with an engraved dash; digits, letters or both; a refused character shakes its slot; a wrong code rings every slot and shakes the row; the spinner's small ring while it is checked, then the tick; Resend counts down on the drum.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/code-field.md. SwiftUI: MetalCodeField, MetalCodeFieldResend in the MetalUI Swift package.
